residual_limitations: Primary visual replication remains 36 pairs from 18 interventions and 12 sources, including nine held-out sources. Only 18/116 qualified interventions yield contrasts; selection is mechanism-conditioned.
Support-only conflicts at operations 3-7, including 24/36 at operation three, do not establish required long-horizon simulation or changed path-clearance reasoning.
Strong shallow/search controls and the 2260/3829 inverse-last baseline constrain difficulty and nonlocal-repair interpretations.

Restricted deterministic ceilings do not exclude local cues, silhouette/framing, source templates, stochastic policies, routing memorization, or released-bank access; zero deterministic joint ceiling is not a stochastic chance baseline.

Registered sites, IDs, inventories, clamped connectivity, inset collision proxies, and straight translations omit general mechanics, forces, grasping, arbitrary poses, and real rack transport. Public CAD may overlap pretraining.

Pixel distinction and assumed competent collection do not establish empirical answerability, human-model gaps, favorable rankings, active-view benefits, or empirical superiority. Source-level uncertainty is conditional on retained sources.
The runtime archive is not a full construction checkout; matching dependencies and separate policy-host isolation remain necessary.
The lengthy supplement remains a reference census. Future venue preflight and real submission metadata are not certified. Final commit synchronization and external hosting remain outside this review.
acceptance_rationale: P2 is substantively closed in the actual rendered and packaged artifacts, with unchanged scientific content and no observed regression. The prior coherent, exact, auditable diagnostic contribution still meets the frozen rubric under the experiment-complete assumption. Incremental novelty, modest support-only replication, strong shortcut controls, and empirical uncertainty still cap the independent recommendation at 7. Correcting a legend removes a defect but is not a stronger scientific contribution; the score is not an arithmetic mean.
